subject.title: fix(exact-review): bound review retries with an attempt ceiling

question: Should exact-review work that fails eight consecutive completion attempts be parked for explicit recovery rather than continue automatic retries indefinitely?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but choosing the retry budget and the operational tradeoff between bounded Actions consumption and automatic recovery from a prolonged external outage is a policy decision.

options.title: Accept the eight-attempt ceiling
options.body: Park review items after eight failed completions and rely on a verified head update or explicit re-review command to resume them.

options.title: Use a different recovery policy
options.body: Keep the bounded design but adjust the limit or add a bounded automatic recheck path if maintainers require longer outage tolerance.

recommendation.title: Accept the eight-attempt ceiling
recommendation.body: Park review items after eight failed completions and rely on a verified head update or explicit re-review command to resume them.
